# Seclayer

> Automated black-box security scanning for web applications — built for vibe coders who ship fast.

Seclayer performs automated black-box security scans on web applications you own or are
authorised to test. Paste a URL and receive a plain-English security report powered by DeepSeek
AI, usually within ten minutes, with no installs or agents required.

Every scan is a full scan. There are no tiers to choose between.

Seclayer is an automated scanner, not a manual penetration test. It is not passive: it sends
real probe traffic to the target, including injection payloads and a port scan. Scan only what
you own or have permission to test.

## What Seclayer does

- Runs automated black-box security scans against a publicly reachable web application
- Aligned with the OWASP Top 10. Strongest on security misconfiguration (A05), cryptographic
  and transport failures (A02), and vulnerable components (A06). Covers broken access control
  (A01) with a two-account comparison and identifier mutation, injection (A03) through active
  probing, and SSRF (A10) through an out-of-band callback collector when one is configured
- Scans as a logged-in user when you supply credentials: paste a session cookie or bearer
  token, or hand it a login form. It notices when a session dies mid-scan and signs back in
  rather than quietly finishing the scan logged out
- Discovers the API surface from an OpenAPI spec or, when none exists, from the JavaScript
  bundle, then tests each endpoint for missing authentication, IDOR, BFLA, injection, excessive
  data exposure, rate limiting and mass assignment
- Assigns a letter grade (A through F) with a numeric risk score (0–100)
- Generates plain-English reports via DeepSeek that explain findings and prioritise fixes
- Provides per-agent fix prompts tailored to Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt and Replit AI
- Offers continuous monitoring with weekly rescans and daily CVE feed matching

## Who Seclayer is for

Vibe coders, solo founders, indie developers and dev agencies who build with AI code generation
tools (Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, Replit) and need to verify security before launching — or after
every coding session.

## Pricing

Free during early access. Every scan and continuous monitoring are free while the platform is
being fine-tuned. There is no checkout and no paid tier at present.

## Security checks performed

Headers: Content-Security-Policy (including unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval detection),
Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy,
Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection

Transport: HTTPS enforcement, TLS version and cipher strength, certificate validity and expiry

Cookies: Secure flag, HttpOnly flag, SameSite attribute

CORS: wildcard and reflected-origin detection

Disclosure: Server header, X-Powered-By, technology fingerprinting, source maps, exposed
configuration files

Injection: reflected XSS, error-based SQL injection, path traversal and LFI on discovered
parameters

Access control: two-account comparison for IDOR and BFLA, plus identifier mutation to find
records nothing linked to

API: endpoint discovery followed by missing-authentication, injection, data-exposure,
rate-limiting and mass-assignment testing

Backend services: Supabase and Firebase rules probing, including a single self-cleaning write
probe against tables that are already open

Reconnaissance: TCP connect scan across common ports, subdomain enumeration, DNS and email
security records, subdomain takeover detection

Components: known-CVE matching and end-of-life version detection

## How it works

1. Paste a URL for an application you own or are authorised to test
2. Optionally supply credentials so the scan can test the authenticated surface, and a second
   account so it can test access control between users
3. The scanner fetches the target, renders it if it is a single-page app, discovers its API
   surface, runs its probes, and calls DeepSeek for analysis
4. Receive a report with grade, risk score, findings and fix prompts

## Scope and safety

- Scans send active traffic. Injection payloads, path traversal attempts and a port scan are
  part of a normal scan
- Targets that resolve to private, loopback or link-local addresses are refused, on the first
  request and on every redirect
- Storing login credentials for a scan requires a registered, verified account
- Write testing is limited to a single self-cleaning probe against a backend table that is
  already publicly writable, to demonstrate the exposure
- No credential brute-forcing, no destructive requests, no denial-of-service testing

## Technical details

- Built on: Node.js / Express, React / Vite, PostgreSQL, pg-boss queue
- Deployed as two services: a web tier and a separate scanner tier that consumes a job queue
- AI: DeepSeek (deepseek-chat model)
- Auth: email and password with verified email; anonymous scanning is also supported
- No agents, browser extensions or code changes required
